name: SOLARIS-23
description: SOLARIS-23: a microtonal drone and ambient machine. Four classic drones of five free-running saws each (tune every oscillator, a light sensor, VOLT for FM), two chaos drones (sirens, birds, surf), two morphing VCOs on the pads, two LFOs, a joystick, a 5-step sequencer, a dual 12 dB filter, distortion and a dual effector of 24 programs. The same engine as the SOLARIS-23 VST3.
author: swtdr34mz
